rows.description: I spilled ink on a friend's book and feel my face burn. Shame says I am bad, while guilt says I did a bad thing. I can apologise and offer to fix it.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: forgiveness, humiliation

rows.description: The whole class laughs when I stammer or fall on stage. I want to disappear. Most of them forget soon; a friend who stands by me matters more than the laughter.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: forgiveness, shame

rows.description: My mother forgives me quickly when I confess a mistake. I feel a weight lift. Being forgiven teaches me that a mistake can be mended and does not end love.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: humiliation, shame

rows.description: The teacher scolds me sharply for a slip. I feel ashamed and defensive. Listening to what I can learn, without deciding I am useless, helps me grow.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: forgiveness, humiliation, shame

rows.description: I broke something at home and hid the pieces. The secret feels heavy. Telling the truth, even late, usually brings relief and shows my parents I can be trusted.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: forgiveness, humiliation, shame

rows.description: A classmate draws or sings beautifully and I am amazed. Admiring others opens my heart, and I can ask how she practises instead of thinking I could never do it.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: comparison, envy, insecurity, jealousy, pride

rows.description: Everyone praises my classmate's talent and I feel invisible. Envy shows me what I care about. I can work on my own strengths instead of running down hers.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, comparison, insecurity, jealousy, pride

rows.description: My parents say, look at your cousin, he is so good. I feel crushed. I can say that I am trying in my own way and ask them to notice what I do well.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, envy, insecurity, jealousy, pride

rows.description: I won a prize for my talent and love the applause. Pride is healthy; I stay humble by thanking those who taught me and helping others who are learning.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, comparison, envy, insecurity, jealousy
related mind states: affection, gratitude, pride

rows.description: My friend goes cold after I win a contest. I feel confused and guilty for winning. I can stay kind, give him space and remind him that his friendship matters to me.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, comparison, envy, insecurity, pride
related mind states: guilt, confusion, jealousy
